title: Glass to Bottle
description: This is a very small mod that by passes having to use 3 glass to make 3 glass bottles into only using 1 glass to make a singular glass bottle!
body:
This was created becasue of an issue I ran into while playing Minecraft. Very small light weight mod that adds a new recipe to fixe having to use 3 glass to make 3 glass bottles, vs only using 1 glass to make 1 glass bottle!

 _*Will **ONLY** be realeased in forge 1.20.1*_
